passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: I have a friend, and his name is Tom.
phrases.ko: 나에게는 친구가 있고, 그의 이름은 톰이에요.
phrases.zh: 我有一个朋友，他叫汤姆。
phrases.py: wǒ yǒu yí gè péng yǒu， tā jiào tāng mǔ。

phrases.en: We are in the same class.
phrases.py: wǒ men zài tóng yī gè bān。

phrases.en: Tom can be kind, and he is a good friend.
phrases.ko: 톰은 친절할 수 있고, 좋은 친구예요.
phrases.zh: 汤姆会很善良，他是个好朋友。
phrases.py: tāng mǔ huì hěn shàn liáng， tā shì gè hǎo péng yǒu。
fàng xué hòu wǒ men tī zú qiú。

phrases.en: We share a snack when we are hungry.
phrases.py: wǒ men è le jiù fēn xiǎng líng shí。

phrases.en: His name is easy, and I like to say it.
phrases.ko: 그의 이름은 쉽고, 나는 그 이름을 부르는 것이 좋아요.
phrases.zh: 他的名字很简单，我喜欢叫他。
phrases.py: tā de míng zì hěn jiǎn dān， wǒ xǐ huān jiào tā。

phrases.en: We sit in the same row at school.
phrases.py: wǒ men zài xué xiào zuò tóng yī pái。

phrases.en: A good friend listens and waits.
phrases.py: hǎo péng yǒu huì tīng， yě huì děng。

phrases.en: Tom and I walk home after soccer.
phrases.ko: 톰과 나는 축구 후에 집에 걸어서 가요.
phrases.zh: 踢完足球，汤姆和我一起走回家。
phrases.py: tī wán zú qiú， tāng mǔ hé wǒ yì qǐ zǒu huí jiā。

phrases.en: I share my snack because he shares his.
phrases.ko: 톰이 간식을 나눠 주어서 나도 나눠요.
phrases.zh: 他把零食分给我，所以我也分给他。
phrases.py: tā bǎ líng shí fēn gěi wǒ， suǒ yǐ wǒ yě fēn gěi tā。

phrases.en: I am glad we are in the same class.
phrases.zh: 我们在同一个班，我很高兴。
phrases.py: wǒ men zài tóng yī gè bān， wǒ hěn gāo xìng。

full_passage_spoken: I have a friend, and his name is Tom. We are in the same class. Tom can be kind, and he is a good friend. We play soccer after school. We share a snack when we are hungry. His name is easy, and I like to say it. We sit in the same row at school. A good friend listens and waits. Tom and I walk home after soccer. I share my snack because he shares his. I am glad we are in the same class.
full_passage_zh: 我有一个朋友，他叫汤姆。我们在同一个班。汤姆会很善良，他是个好朋友。放学后我们踢足球。我们饿了就分享零食。他的名字很简单，我喜欢叫他。我们在学校坐同一排。好朋友会听，也会等。踢完足球，汤姆和我一起走回家。他把零食分给我，所以我也分给他。我们在同一个班，我很高兴。
